channel.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
channel.description: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

item.title: Trump to meet with Russia's Putin and China's Xi for historic joint meeting
item.description: President Trump will meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi on Thursday for a historic three-way meeting.

item.title: Former U.S. ambassador on Trump's joint summit with leaders of China and Russia
item.description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks to Nicholas Burns, former U.S. ambassador to China and NATO, about President Trump's planned meeting with the leaders of China and Russia.

item.title: White House withdraws nominee for FDA commissioner
item.description: Ahead of an anticipated Senate committee vote, the Trump administration has withdrawn the nomination of Dr. Heidi Overton to be the next Food and Drug Administration commissioner.
item.content:encoded: Ahead of an anticipated Senate committee vote, the Trump administration has withdrawn the nomination of Dr. Heidi Overton to be the next Food and Drug Administration commissioner.

item.title: She retired early to care for family. New work rules for food aid disrupted that
item.description: The Trump administration's sweeping changes to SNAP food aid mean older adults up to age 65 must work or volunteer to get the benefit.

item.title: Families of victims of D.C.-area midair collision push for more safety measures
item.description: Families of people killed in a midair crash in Washington, D.C., pushed lawmakers for more safety measures, amid the Trump administration calls for $50 billion after Friday's nationwide ground stop.

item.title: Voyager One becomes the first spacecraft to reach one light-day from Earth
item.description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with NASA's Nicky Fox about the legacy of Voyager 1 and its achievement of traveling one light-day from Earth.

item.title: Air Force major arrested for protesting Trump is being held in solitary, lawyer says
item.description: Air Force Maj. Jason Watson was arrested after protesting the Trump administration while on the U.S. Capitol steps in uniform. His lawyers say he has been held in solitary confinement ever since.
